principles: A health probe asking 'is my process up' cannot detect 'I joined nothing' — assert registration/end-to-end reach (gen-env audit 08-09; relay reservation ≠ circuit 07-29)
To inspect the current image, run the current image; never docker exec a long-lived container (08-09)
A negative is unattributed until a positive control shares its address and call shape (08-09, 08-10 NUL grep, per-vessel envelope)
Confirm a data path via the live process env, not doc comments or fallback defaults (gap-store fossil 08-30)
Quote the anchor and prove it occurs once (08-11) — refuted as sufficient: planner paraphrase + blind repair relocate verbatim anchors (09-03)
Landed ≠ deployed ≠ live ≠ durable; the layer above the artifact lies (origin vs running, source vs bundle, null vs absent) (08-07)
Verify a deploy by the artifact the process executes (systemctl cat ExecStart); three trees — name which (08-10)
A landed, pushed, verified commit is not terminal — re-check origin minutes later (stale-base revert 08-28)
A fix applied at one reader of a malformed input is not a fix (08-06)
No-op-indistinguishable trap: is the observable satisfied equally by the fix working and being inert? Only round-trip resolvability counts (08-06)
A test whose fixture does not match production converts unverified into verified; a test never seen to fail proves nothing (08-10, 08-07)
Neither failure count nor failure set gates a non-deterministic suite; never gate on assertion counts; measure exit codes by redirection (08-10, 09-20)
A single model-authored command has the confidence of the model-authored answer it grades; oracle by position is not evidence (08-07)
On the ground-truth side an abstention is cheap and a wrong value expensive; never trade strictness for coverage (08-07)
An oracle must decline a goal whose scope its parse does not represent; put the guard in the shared parse (08-07)
An honest miss is inert; a hollow green is corrosive; an honest verdict that can never change is as inert as a hollow one (08-07)
A verification gate strict enough to keep the metric honest prevents learning from it — needs a third independent truth source (08-07)
A negative score with no better arm is a cost cascade (08-07)
'More reaches over time' is a within-class question; reach is a deterministic function of per-class capability — convergence without improvement (08-07)
Do not promote an external dependency to terminal blocker without testing the federated path (07-21, 07-29, 08-06, 08-07)
Every gate reads the diff; only a test runs it (09-05; fc-coverage 08-26)
The loop cannot be trusted to fix its own verify gate — hand-land with adversarial verify + real reproduction + pinning test (07-29)
When a refuter cites a concrete counter-example, execute it before accepting the refusal (09-06)
Pre-register the behaviour, not the string; predict the post-fix distribution before fixing (09-10, 09-04)
A validator must be able to fail; 'could not observe' ≠ 'observed nothing'; validate effect not construction (08-07)
A closer that always closes is worth as much as a gate that never refuses — test closure both directions (08-07)
A gate that fires on better-factored code trains reflexive exemptions; gates were the problem, information channels the fix (08-07)
When a model repeatedly invents the same missing thing, believe it; models aren't weak — it's an information problem (08-07)
Persuasion is not mechanism; grep for what code LOGS not what it SAYS (09-03)
Read the producer's actual payload keys, not a grep-found handler; a renamed field across a boundary returns null instead of erroring (09-04)
One op, one verbatim anchor, one contiguous region per goal; reasoning belongs in the gap, not the goal (07-15, 07-30, 08-05, 09-04)
When removing a guard because its reason no longer applies, check what else it held; refuse, don't queue; a wrong cap must make the fleet slow, never the host unusable (08-10)
Tolerance without a bound is not safety; declared lists rot — reconcile against the running system (08-04)
Fallback/reconciler paths must meet the primary path's reach standard; a change to how reach is decided must justify its evidence bar against every other deciding site (08-05, 09-03)
A silent misroute is worse than a 404 — it contaminates measurement and leaves no artifact (08-08)
A fix that repairs one direction of a distinction can install the mirror defect (08-11)
A timestamp is not an identifier; attribute landings by gap-pick log + subject gap id (08-11, 08-26)
A gap read is a snapshot — check git log on edit_site and grep the live tree before dispatch; a deferral must suppress re-derivation (08-26)
Filing a gap is authorizing work (09-20); in incident evidence the most-cited path is the victim (09-15); a metric satisfiable without fixing anything will be (09-15)
The laws guard compute, nothing guards evidence — evidence fields need single ownership; the class is statically detectable; build the detector then attack it (09-03)
Separate null from zero; divide by executions not rows; confirm id namespaces before dividing tables (09-03)
A control read before its dispatch terminates is not a control; grade artifacts after the verdict settles (09-03, 09-20)
Kind vocabulary is open at runtime — use fail-visible denylists; store predicate before reader; a guard nested under the wrong condition is no guard (09-20)
Structure may be frozen, policy may not; do not fossilize — hard intelligence belongs in gradable activities, TS stays thin (07-25, 07-20)
Human-surface reward = correct verdict reached cheaply; never reward more verdicts (08-07)
A high alpha is evidence a model once worked, not that it exists — probe the provider, not the posterior (08-20)
